subject: NimbusCare — evidence cadence, audit routing, and pen-test window
messages:
From: Anna Li <anna.li@nimbuscare.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbuscare.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal checklist — audit rights + pen-test timing

Sean / Laura,

We're working through our renewal checklist and need to lock down two things before legal signs off: (1) the audit rights / security exhibit language in the MSA/order form, and (2) a firm pen-test window and evidence cadence so our InfoSec team can plan. I've attached a short questionnaire with the items our security review requires.

High level asks from NimbusCare:
- Confirm SOC 2 type 2 attestation period and whether Redwood will provide the report on execution.
- Confirm whether a vendor-hosted pen test is supported or if we need on-site read-only access.
- Proposed 2-week pen test window in late August — can you confirm availability?
- A list of evidence owners and expected artifact delivery cadence (logs, config snapshots, network diagrams).

We'd like to get contractual language suggestions for the order form (sample redline would be ideal). Can we schedule a 30-minute sync next week?

Thanks,
Anna Li
Senior Procurement Manager
NimbusCare
Attachment: Nimbus_Security_Request_2024.pdf
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@nimbuscare.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2024 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal checklist — audit rights + pen-test timing

Anna — appreciate the clear checklist. Looping in Karthik from Security for technical confirmations; Laura from Legal to coordinate order-form wording.

Quick answers up front:
- Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II attestation for the period Jan–Jun 2024; we can share the report under NDA.
- We support remote/read-only evidence collection for pen tests and will provide temporary read-only access for forensic artifacts; we prefer a vendor-coordinated test (we can host the tester or accept your vendor following our access rules).
- Tentative pen-test window: Aug 19–Sep 1 (two-week, with a 3-day buffer either side). If you need earlier dates we can discuss.

Karthik — can you confirm the evidence list and who should own artifacts (SOC report, access logs, config snapshots, audit logs)? Also note any constraints around redacting customer data.

Anna — I'll draft suggested redline language for the order form and share a short runbook for evidence handoff prior to our sync. Proposed meeting: Mon 22 Jul 10:00 PT or Tue 23 Jul 13:00 PT — which works for you?

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Anna Li <anna.li@nimbuscare.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2024 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal checklist — audit rights + pen-test timing

Sean / Laura / Anna — thanks for the details. A few clarifications and a proposed evidence cadence:

1) SOC 2:
- We have the SOC 2 Type II report for Jan–Jun 2024. We can provide the full report under a mutual NDA and a purpose-limited distribution list.

2) Pen test:
- Redwood supports vendor-led remote pen tests and vendor-hosted onsite tests under a short access window. For remote tests we provide read-only interfaces and synthetic accounts where possible.
- Proposed firm window: Aug 19–Aug 30 (we reserve Aug 31–Sep 1 as buffer for fixes/verification).

3) Evidence cadence and owners (proposed):
- SOC report: Security Ops (karthik_iyer) — deliverable: final PDF within 3 business days after NDA execution.
- Access logs (7-day rolling): Infra Ops (laura_bennett) — snapshot delivered within 2 business days of request.
- Configuration snapshots / deployment manifests: Platform Eng (dev_patel) — shared within 3 business days.
- Network diagrams / architecture overview (redacted PII): Security Docs (marissa_cole) — within 5 business days.

4) Contract language notes:
- We prefer a limited-scope audit clause: read-only access, on-site only if necessary, pre-notification windows (48 hours), and requirements to avoid exfiltration of customer data.
- We ask that the MSA include the ability to designate a mutually agreed third-party auditor and require a redaction process for customer-identifying info before external distribution.

Attachments to share: SOC2_Report_Q1_2024.pdf, PenTest_Guidelines.docx (internal playbook with our tester rules).

I'll be available for the sync on Mon 22 Jul 10:00 PT.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Anna Li <anna.li@nimbuscare.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Torres <michael.torres@nimbuscare.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2024 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal checklist — audit rights + pen-test timing

Thanks Karthik — that cadence looks reasonable. A few follow-ups from NimbusCare Legal/InfoSec:

- We need sample redline language for the Order Form that explicitly allows NimbusCare or its designated auditor to request "reasonable and narrowly tailored" access for one-time audits, limited to the scope of the SOC / controls in-scope. Can you provide two alternatives: (A) read-only, remote-first; (B) on-site allowed with prior written approval and mutually agreed controls.
- For the SOC report: we'll execute a short mutual NDA to receive the report. Please route the PDF to procurement@nimbuscare.com once NDA is signed.
- Pen test: NimbusCare prefers to use an accredited third-party tester. They require a 2-week window and an assurance that evidence (access logs, VM images if applicable) will be available for 30 days post-test. Is Redwood able to retain requested artifacts for 30 days?

We can take Mon 22 Jul 10:00 PT — I'll send a calendar invite. Attached: brief redline examples from our counsel (redlines_anon.docx).

Regards,
Anna Li
Senior Procurement Manager
NimbusCare
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 25 Jul 2024 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal checklist — audit rights + pen-test timing

Anna — great sync today. Summary and next steps:

Agreed items:
- Order form redlines: Laura will produce two alternatives (A: remote/read-only; B: on-site allowed with pre-approval and controls). Expect drafts by EOD Fri 26 Jul.
- SOC 2 report: Redwood will execute NimbusCare NDA and transmit SOC2_Report_Q1_2024.pdf to procurement@nimbuscare.com within 2 business days of NDA execution.
- Pen test window: Tentatively Aug 19–Aug 30. NimbusCare to confirm tester details; Redwood will provide evidence retention for 30 days post-test (access logs, snapshots) unless otherwise negotiated.
- Evidence owners: Karthik (SOC/controls), Laura (access logs), Dev (config snapshots) — see detailed owner matrix in Drive (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cNimbusSecurityPlaybook).

Action items and owners:
- Laura Bennett: draft two redline alternatives for the order form (due 2024-07-26).
- Karthik Iyer: prepare SOC delivery checklist and pen-test runbook with minimum artifact list (due 2024-07-30).
- Sean Gallagher: update HubSpot deal NIM-2024-047 with agreed timeline and share DocuSign link for NDA.
- Anna / NimbusCare: confirm third-party tester and send contact details by 2024-07-31.

If anything here is off, flag it in reply-all. Otherwise we'll treat these as the working plan and proceed with the redlines and NDA.

Best regards,
Sean Gallagher

Redwood Inference
